title: Binance Options Will Launch XRPUSDT Weekly Options
text: * Update: This announcement was last updated on 2023-05-18 to reflect that Binance will launch XRPUSDT Weekly Options on 2023-05-19 at 08:00 (UTC). The listing was previously postponed until further notice. Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch XRPUSDT Weekly Options on 2023-05-19 at 08:00 (UTC). Please note:   XRPUSDT Weekly Options are European-style options contracts.  New XRPUSDT Weekly Options contracts will be listed every Thursday at 08:00 (UTC). For more information on contract specifications, please refer to  Binance Options  Contract Specifications . Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support!
